name: Northern HSC Trust — Paediatric ADHD Assessment Service
description: Local Northern Ireland child ADHD service information describing triage, specialist-nurse assessment and paediatrician assessment within the Northern HSC Trust.
intended_use: Inspect one current child ADHD pathway in Northern Ireland while keeping it explicitly Trust-specific rather than region-wide.
audience_or_context: Children and young people, parents/carers and supporters in the Northern Health and Social Care Trust area.
limitations: This is a Northern HSC Trust pathway and does not establish referral rules for the other Northern Ireland HSC Trusts.
Waiting and eligibility rules can change.
Medication discussion after diagnosis is separate from whether a diagnosis is reached.
cost_or_access_notes: HSC access depends on current Trust catchment, referral and eligibility arrangements.
conflicts_of_interest: Northern HSC Trust describes a service it provides; ND Oracle records the local route without generalising it to Northern Ireland as a whole.

provenance.method: Current Northern Trust Paediatric ADHD Assessment Service page checked on 2026-09-03 for assessment stages and local-service scope. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
